query: What is the maximum width of a vehicle allowed to enter where the corresponding road sign prohibits vehicles with width in excess of 2.3m?
reference_answer: The maximum permissible width is 2.3 meters.
context:
[Document 1]
The maximum permissible width is 2.3 meters.

[Document 2]
A single group QR code can contain up to 10 profiles.For travellers who selected "Motorcycle" as the vehicle type, only a maximum of two profiles are allowed in this group QR code.For travellers who selected "Lorry" or “Bus” as the vehicle type, only a maximum of four profiles are allowed in this group QR code.Nevertheless, travellers are free to create and customise multiple groups of QR codes, depending on their travel needs.

[Document 3]
Give way to vehicles from the side road entering the main road.

[Document 4]
The stopping distance of a vehicle increases to about twice that on a dry road due to less friction between tyres and the wet surface.

answer: The maximum width of a vehicle allowed to enter where the sign prohibits vehicles wider than 2.3m is 2.3 meters, according to [Document 1].
